description: Stationnement PMR Nevers Agglomération is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération de Nevers. Parking PMR Nevers Agglomeration. PMR spaces are spaces designed to facilitate parking for people with reduced mobility. Due to their size and location, close to public establishments and shops, they facilitate the entry or exit of the vehicle and reduce the distance to access services located nearby. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération de Nevers. The portal shows the English title as "Parking PMR Nevers Agglomeration" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération de Nevers. Its keywords include handicap, accessibilite, stationnement, pmr. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, GEOJSON, JSON. The listing shows 2018-05-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
